title.en: Debate: a tax on AI profits?
title.sw: Mjadala: kodi kwa mapato ya akili bandia?

summary.en: Germany's governing parties are debating a tax on money earned with artificial intelligence. Family minister Karin Prien supports it. There are no concrete plans yet.
summary.sw: Vyama vya serikali ya Ujerumani vinajadili kodi kwa pesa zinazopatikana kwa akili bandia (AI). Waziri wa familia Karin Prien anaiunga mkono. Bado hakuna mipango thabiti.

title.en: Berlin police ready for Saturday protests
title.sw: Polisi wa Berlin wajiandaa kwa maandamano ya Jumamosi

summary.en: About 1,500 extra police will work in Berlin on 31 October. Around 10,000 people are expected at the Brandenburg Gate. Police say they know of no calls for violence.
summary.sw: Polisi wapatao 1,500 wa ziada watafanya kazi Berlin tarehe 31 Oktoba. Watu karibu 10,000 wanatarajiwa Brandenburger Tor. Polisi wanasema hawana taarifa za wito wa vurugu.

title.en: One year since the 2025 election violence
title.sw: Mwaka mmoja tangu vurugu za uchaguzi 2025

summary.en: Tanzania marks one year since the 29 October 2025 election and the violence after it. A government inquiry recorded at least 518 deaths. A new commission is now collecting evidence in Dar es Salaam.
summary.sw: Tanzania inaadhimisha mwaka mmoja tangu uchaguzi wa tarehe 29 Oktoba 2025 na vurugu zilizofuata. Tume ya uchunguzi ya serikali ilirekodi vifo visivyopungua 518. Tume mpya sasa inakusanya ushahidi Dar es Salaam.

title.en: Plan for a Dar es Salaam city authority
title.sw: Mpango wa mamlaka ya jiji la Dar es Salaam

summary.en: Deputy minister Festo Dugange told Parliament the government is combining two studies into one plan for a Dar es Salaam Metropolitan Authority. There is no deadline yet.
summary.sw: Naibu waziri Festo Dugange aliambia Bunge kuwa serikali inaunganisha tafiti mbili kuwa mpango mmoja wa Mamlaka ya Jiji la Dar es Salaam. Bado hakuna tarehe ya mwisho.

title.en: Research on violence against women and children
title.sw: Utafiti kuhusu ukatili dhidi ya wanawake na watoto

summary.en: The human rights commission (CHRAGG) is researching abuse in Arusha and Dar es Salaam. Arusha recorded 3,400 violence cases in 2025/26, and a new support centre is planned in Karatu.
summary.sw: Tume ya haki za binadamu (CHRAGG) inafanya utafiti wa ukatili Arusha na Dar es Salaam. Arusha ilirekodi kesi 3,400 za ukatili mwaka 2025/26, na kituo kipya cha msaada kimepangwa Karatu.

question.en: Which word fits? "Die Polizei hat ___ Informationen."
question.sw: Neno gani linafaa? "Die Polizei hat ___ Informationen."

explanation.en: B: keine. Use kein/keine to say "no" before a noun. Plural and feminine nouns take keine (keine Informationen, keine Zeit). Masculine and neuter take kein (kein Auto). Nicht does not go before a noun here. Five words: die Polizei = police; die Information = information; der Samstag = Saturday; die Stadt = city (review); die Uhr = clock, o'clock (review). Review: Die Demo beginnt am Samstag um 14 Uhr (am for days, um for clock times). Emin: Polisi hawana taarifa. Hawana = hawa + na negative: they do not have. Swahili negative sits inside the verb, German adds kein. This practice does not prove exam readiness.
explanation.sw: B: keine. Tumia kein/keine kusema "hakuna" mbele ya nomino. Nomino za wingi na za kike hutumia keine (keine Informationen, keine Zeit). Za kiume na za kati hutumia kein (kein Auto). Nicht haifai hapa mbele ya nomino. Maneno matano: die Polizei = polisi; die Information = taarifa; der Samstag = Jumamosi; die Stadt = mji (marudio); die Uhr = saa (marudio). Marudio: Die Demo beginnt am Samstag um 14 Uhr (am kwa siku, um kwa saa). Emin: Polisi hawana taarifa. Hawana = hawa + na hasi: hawana maana hawana. Kiswahili huweka hasi ndani ya kitenzi, Kijerumani huongeza kein. Mazoezi haya hayathibitishi utayari wa mtihani.
